text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O and her Trainer arrive 
to watch the year-end grand finale, the 
Arima Kinen.

Sakura Bakushin O's heart swells with 
pride, believing that the Arima Kinen is 
the truly fitting race for the Class 
Representative to enter.

Given her aptitude, running the Arima 
Kinen would be next to impossible... That 
said, this motivation of hers could 
certainly be put to good use.

The Trainer asks Sakura Bakushin O for 
even greater speed, and she rises to the 
challenge.
